summary: Restore the missing preterit-wa ending in mwaʕad-wa.
rationale: The supplied corpus at 52/34 reads mwaʕadwayle. The same passage is quoted in the wʕd entry, stem II Preterit-wa, as mwaʕád-way-le. The dgl quotation drops the ending -y-le; restoring it is more than a clitic-boundary normalization.
